1. (Currently amended) A method of treating a brain, comprising: inserting an elongated device into the brain to create a path __within white matter tracts__; radially expanding the device to create a working channel along the path; and introducing a medical element into the working channel to perform a medical procedure on the brain.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the medical element is __a surgical instrument for tissue ablation or resection__.

3. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the medical element is a medicament __delivered under pressure to achieve localized therapeutic concentration__.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising creating an opening in a cranium, and inserting the elongated device through the opening __such that the device is positioned to create the working channel without direct contact with gray matter structures__.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers within the brain __by means of a cannula that is withdrawn after the device is positioned__.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising radially contracting and removing the device from the brain __while maintaining the integrity of the working channel__.

7. (Currently amended) A method of treating a tissue, comprising: placing an elongated device into the tissue to create a path __by sequential advancement and radial expansion stages__; radially expanding the device against the tissue to radially displace the tissue along the path; radially reinforcing the device against the tissue __with a stent structure that remains in place__; and introducing a medical element through the device to perform a medical procedure on the tissue.

8. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7, wherein the medical element is __a surgical instrument for tissue manipulation or removal__.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7, wherein the medical element is a medicament __in liquid or gel form delivered through a catheter__.

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers __using a dissection technique that separates tissue planes without tearing__.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7, further comprising radially contracting and removing the device from the tissue __while preserving the reinforced working channel__.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 7, further comprising treating the tissue in contact with the device with a haemostatic compound to reduce bleeding __by applying the compound to tissue surfaces exposed during radial expansion__.

13. (Currently amended) A method of treating a tissue, comprising: placing an elongated device, having a first radially expandable body, surrounded by a stent, which is surrounded by a second radially expandable body, into the tissue to create a path __by sequential positioning within tissue planes__; radially expanding the second expandable body against the tissue to radially displace the tissue along the path __in a controlled manner to create tissue separation__; radially expanding the first expandable body to radially expand the stent to reinforce the second expandable body against the tissue __such that the stent maintains structural support__; radially contracting and removing the first expandable body to create a working channel through the stent __while the stent remains expanded and in place__; introducing a medical element through the channel to perform a medical procedure on the tissue __via the stent-lined channel__; and radially contracting the second expandable body and removing the device from the tissue __leaving the stent as a permanent or semi-permanent structure__.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, wherein the medical element is __a surgical instrument for accessing tissue structures beyond the working channel__.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, wherein the medical element is a medicament __delivered through the stent-lined channel to target tissue__.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers __by means of controlled dissection that maintains tissue plane integrity__.

17. (Previously presented) The method of claim 13, further comprising treating the tissue in contact with the device with a haemostatic compound to reduce bleeding.
